summary:
Today, we are here to present our project called SPACE MM – Space Mission Mars.
Our project is based on exploring the planet Mars and discovering whether it could be a suitable place for living things in the future.
We are interested in finding out whether humans could live on Mars, whether plants could grow there, whether water is available, and whether the environment could support life.
Through this project, we aim to understand the surface, atmosphere, temperature, soil, and other important conditions of Mars.
We also want to explore how rockets, spacecraft, and robotic rovers can help us study this mysterious planet.
Our ultimate goal is to discover whether Mars could become a possible home for living things in the future.
Thank you!
